mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_model (model_name, model_version, protocol_type, status) VALUES (#{m.modelName}, #{m.modelVersion}, #{m.protocolType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{m.status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_model SET model_name = #{m.modelName}, model_version = #{m.modelVersion}, protocol_type = #{m.protocolType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status = #{m.status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE model_key = #{m.modelKey}
